name: Tsarin Korniyenko
original_name: ツァーリン コルニエンコ
source:
A foreign language teacher at Haruki's school.  With her well-groomed, bright scarlet hair and model-like proportions, she is a celebrity at her school. 

Her overly distinctive, revealing upper-body attire is common in the region where she was born (in regions where many long-haired people live, they don't wear clothes).

Although there is no legal problem, she still attracts a lot of stares. However, she herself acts with dignity, and is adored by students of both sexes on campus as an intelligent teacher who is sometimes strict and sometimes kind. 

Although she came to Haruki's country 3 years ago, she speaks fluently and beautifully as if she were a native.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
